data.name: Emmerencia
data.gender_notes: Emmerencia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin 'emmerus' meaning 'earth', and 'merens' meaning 'strong'. The name Emmerencia signifies strength and solidity, rooted in the earth. The name Emmerencia carries the meaning “Strength of the Earth” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Emmerencia usually hope their child will grow to embody strength of the earth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Emmerencia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strength of the Earth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Emmerencia total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_greek.name: Εμμηρεντία
in_greek.meaning: Εργάζεται καλώς, Θυγατέρα δυνάμεως, Ψυχή αὐτοθέσμος

in_latin.name: Emmerencia
in_latin.meaning: Facit bonum, Filiam virtutis, Anima ipsa

in_english.name: Emmerencia
in_english.meaning: Does good, Daughter of strength, Self-sustaining soul
in_english.long_meaning: Does good - Etymology from Hebrew 'omer' meaning 'to complete, to accomplish' and 'anet' meaning 'good, pleasant' Daughter of strength - Etymology from Latin 'filiam' meaning 'daughter' and 'virtutis' meaning 'strength, fortitude' Self-sustaining soul - Etymology from Latin 'anima' meaning 'soul, spirit' and 'ipsa' meaning 'autonomous, self-sufficient'.

data.cultural_impact: The name Emmerencia has rich cultural roots, bearing connections to the Latin language and the ancient Roman influence on Christianity. This beautiful name keeps alive the classical and powerful traditions of the past, resonating with a profound sense of history and ethical values.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual dimension of Emmerencia stems from its etymology; inner strength and connection to the earth. As a Christian name, this meaning is deepened further with the Biblical connotations of faith, humility, and bearing the Cross - all rooted in the foundational concepts of Christianity. Ultimately, Emmerencia as a name encompasses both worldly and spiritual dimensions, encouraging those who bear it to remain grounded while maintaining an unyielding faith and resilient spirit.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Emmerencia: God's eternity in strength and mercy, ever ready to console and protect.
